_comment: Explicit overrides mapping the trained model's feature names (original CSE-CIC-IDS2018,
abbreviated style) to the corrected Engelen et al. CNS2022 release (spelled-out style).
70 of 78 features match automatically under normalisation; these 8 do not and are pinned
here by hand. Never guess these at runtime - a silent mismatch is train/serve skew.
Note the corrected release is itself internally inconsistent: 'Total Fwd Packet' is
singular while 'Total Bwd packets' is plural with a lowercase p. That inconsistency is
why the automatic matcher misses the forward variant but catches the backward one.
Also note 'CWE Flag Count' -> 'CWR Flag Count': the original dataset misspelled the TCP
CWR (Congestion Window Reduced) flag as CWE. The corrected release fixes it. That one IS
resolved automatically by the normaliser via its cwe->cwr expansion rule.
_new_columns_note: These six columns do not exist in the original dataset and are therefore absent from the
trained model's feature set. They are NOT used for inference against the existing model.
A retrained model may adopt them - but 'Attempted Category' is label metadata, not a
feature, and must never be used as a detection input (label leakage).
